hack.root_cause: Insider Exit Scam — Malicious Fake Router Pre-Deployed
hack.description: Hope Finance's team deployed a fake swap router and configured the protocol to use it (signed by all 3 multisig owners) before launch, then drained $1.86M in WETH and USDC the moment `openTrade()` was first called.
